summary: Mint Incorporation Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated August 26, 2026, announcing that its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Axonex Intelligence Limited entered a binding development contract with Beijing Yunji Technology Co., Ltd. and Rice Robotics (Hong Kong) Limited to co-develop a commercial-grade service robot. No specific financial terms or stake percentages were disclosed; estimated production is ~1,000 units with projected annual revenue of HK$50–100 million. This is an operational strategic alliance, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer. The filing is routine disclosure of a business development, so no special-situation category applies.
